author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I wonder what I am giving up when upskilling an Opus skill to run in Sonnet or Haiku.

It is cheaper to run, but there must be a trade off somewhere.   Here is my pet theory.

We have Opus -> Sonnet -> Haiku -> bash script
The more we lock down the logic, the more brittle the skill becomes.

Then the question is do we really need the middle tier of Sonnet and Haiku?   Can we just get by with only bash script and Opus?
